name: linea-de-valor-nfl
description: Línea de Valor NFL - Modelos, Parlays y Dinero Profesional

scripts.sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www', {recursive:true}); ['index.html','manifest.webmanifest','sw.js'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f)); fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>f.startsWith('icon-')).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f)); if(fs.existsSync('datos')){ fs.mkdirSync('www/datos', {recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync('datos').forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync('datos/'+f, 'www/datos/'+f)); }" && cap sync android
